title: 花旗策略师：中国市场估值修复，上行空间还有多大？
speaker: Viata Mante

segments.en: Well, that's what my next question was, but what is your top line on China right now? Obviously, tech leads the agenda almost every single day. It's leading the cavalcade of listings here in Hong Kong. I guess how much more legs does it have here in China, the AI trade, and where again?
segments.zh: 您对中国市场的最新看法是什么？科技几乎每天领涨，也带动了香港的上市潮。AI行情在中国还有多大空间？

segments.en: Absolutely. When you look at the index, it's still quite subdued here today, versus the rest. So it was truly one of the bigger luggards within this space. So there is definitely more upside to come.
segments.zh: 从指数看，中国市场相对其他市场仍显低迷，是主要落后市场之一。因此肯定还有更多上行空间。

segments.en: Eventually, of course, China has underperformed because the margins and earnings revisions were moving down, right? So as Korea was moving up and we've been seeing upgrades after abrogates weeks after week, the opposite was happening for China.
segments.zh: 中国此前表现落后，是因为盈利预期在下调。而韩国持续获得上调，中国则相反。

segments.en: Right now, we see stabilization of that. I don't see meaningful upgrades yet. However, if they pick up, then you have a completely different story and a more bullish, longer term or medium-term picture to invest in China.
segments.zh: 目前我们看到盈利预期趋于稳定，但尚未出现明显上调。如果未来上调，那将是完全不同的故事，中期前景会更乐观。

segments.en: For now, there is still a question like whether it's going to come through. For now, it's just a price reaction and reprising of very negative investors sentiment, right?
segments.zh: 目前仍不确定能否实现。现在只是价格反应和投资者情绪修复。

segments.en: It seems to be a macro question now, whether the macro improves in China. I think you mentioned the city's price indices, and it's almost everywhere but China where you are getting the positive revisions higher. So I guess my question is, do you need to see the macro improve for China's not overweight with EM, but EM is now still neutral? What would it take for you to then bump up EM into overweight?
segments.zh: 现在似乎是宏观问题，中国宏观能否改善。花旗经济意外指数显示，除中国外，全球都在上调。那么，什么情况下您会把新兴市场提升为超配？

segments.en: Well, we would really need to see some kind of boost to the consumer, right? So if AI drives the index, you don't need consumers to follow through, but if you want the proper broader index leadership, you need this to come through.
segments.zh: 我们需要看到消费端有所提振。如果AI推动指数，不需要消费跟进；但若想实现更广泛的指数上涨，消费必须跟上。
